title: Alignment leaves show derived wall, share and cpu under a column header
body:
The alignment leaves printed the sum of per-thread durations, which reads as a bug beside the branch wall.

## Proposal

Each leaf prints its wall as share × alignment wall, then the share, then its cpu time, the sum over threads. `threaded_time_pct` already returns the share. The branch line carries `[T threads, cpu Ns, P% busy]`, where busy is cpu ÷ (wall × threads). There is no idle row, since busy already says it. The header sits on the tree rail with a dashed rule:

```text
 └─ alignment: 201.34s (36.13%)   [48 threads, cpu 9,610s, 99.4% busy]
     │                        wall        %      cpu
     │                     -------   ------   ------
     ├─ cloud search       113.02s   56.13%   5,425s
     ├─ backward            34.20s   16.99%   1,642s
```
